description: Catalog your belongings, track purchases, repairs and resale proceeds, and see what each item costs per day. Browse your collection by purchase date or cover image.
name: Itemory

localizedDescriptions.en: Catalog your belongings, track purchases, repairs and resale proceeds, and see what each item costs per day. Browse your collection by purchase date or cover image.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 为每件物品记录购入价格、维修支出和转手收入，查看持有天数与日均成本，在时间线和置物架上回顾自己的物品。
